title: Tesla (TSLA) Seen as ‘Physical AI’ Leader as Mizuho Lifts Price Target
text: Tesla, Inc. (NASDAQ:TSLA) is one of the 10 AI Stocks Making Waves on Wall Street. On January 29, Mizuho analyst Vijay Rakesh raised the price target on the stock to $540.00 (from $530.00) while maintaining an “Outperform” rating.
